title: Branch, PR, quality, and secret-scan gates
objective: Apply repository branch/commit/PR conventions, run staged quality and secret checks, self-review, revalidate latest base, and create one non-Draft PR per Issue after gates pass.
acceptance_criteria: Existing project tools/conventions take precedence; no duplicate tool or hook/CI is silently installed.
Acceptance criteria, required tests, secret scan, self-review, and latest-base revalidation pass before PR creation.
Likely secrets block commit/push and values are redacted.
Each Sub-issue receives one non-Draft PR linked to its Issue; user owns Merge.
Critical blockers prevent PR; non-blocking improvements become approval-gated follow-up proposals.
expected_evidence: secret fixture scan output with redaction
undo_classification: Do not merge or delete branches automatically; preserve evidence and request approval for remote configuration changes.
approval_requirements: Explicit approval before installing tools or changing hooks/CI.
PR creation follows user-approved Issue scope; user retains Merge.
retry_policy: Initial attempt plus at most 2 retries; do not retry secret/permission/config blockers without a change.
